description: On Presto C++ 0.299 the rendered 1_v7 fails the 100,000-element REDUCE cap from SF0.1. With native_expression_max_array_size_in_reduce raised, SF0.1 passes, but SF1 failed with GENERIC_INTERNAL_ERROR after the worker's stuck-operator watchdog cancelled the task at 40 minutes (FilterProject.10::getOutput; peak memory 732954624 bytes), so the cause is neither the cap nor a memory limit. The cause is unknown. Not tested: setting the property with a literal SET SESSION (it was sent as a REST session header), Presto C++ 0.298.x, a multi-worker cluster, and a worker with more than 4 GiB.
